findings.excerpt: For example, we are litigating a number of matters alleging price fixing, monopolization, and consumer protection claims, including those brought by state attorneys general and the Federal Trade Commission.

findings.claim: 2025 年其他營業費用增至 46 億美元，主因 2025 Q3 與 FTC 的訴訟和解，另含義大利稅務爭議與資產減損。
findings.excerpt: The increase in 2025 was primarily related to the settlement of a lawsuit with the Federal Trade Commission (the “FTC”) in Q3 2025, and also included the resolution of tax disputes associated with our stores business in Italy, and physical stores and other asset impairments.

findings.claim: 法官駁回 Amazon 延後 FTC 壟斷案審理的請求，審理維持 2027-03-29。
findings.source: MLex: Amazon's bid to delay US FTC monopolization trial rejected by judge
findings.excerpt: a trial in the US Federal Trade Commission's monopolization case against the company to June 2027. In an order, US District Judge John Chun wrote the he "has been preparing for some time for the March 29, 2027, trial date in this matter." He said he did not "see a good reason to disturb the current schedule."See attached order.

note: FTC 壟斷案（W.D. Wash., Judge Chun）搜尋摘要稱 2026-10-09 法官駁回 Amazon 將 2027-03-29 開庭延到 2027-06 的請求；摘要未提供可逐字引用原文，列入 clues。DOJ/EU 未查到具體來源。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
